blurb: Guests rent power boats, kayaks, canoes, and paddleboards for use on lakes, ponds, and waterways in Maine. Rentals include required safety gear and accessories. Delivery and pick-up services are available for many lakes and ponds.
extraNote: Prices do not include taxes, fuel, damaged or lost items, and delivery fee if applicable · Rental boats delivered at 8am, picked up at 4pm at closest public boat launch · Boats must be clean and full of fuel unless other arrangements made · Excessive dirt, sand, pet hair, or trash incurs $100 cleaning fee · Late returns charged $75 per hour, minimum 1 hour · $550 deposit required to reserve a boat; becomes security deposit upon contract signing · Balance due 30 days prior to rental · Cancellations 0-7 days prior: no refund · Cancellations 8-14 days prior: refund less 50% service fee · Cancellations 15-29 days prior: refund less 25% service fee · Cancellations 30+ days prior: refund less 15%
